title: Sign Out lands on Cognito Client does not exist
description:
Live on development 2026-09-08. Sign Out from the workspace lands on auth-dev.chattic.us/error?error=Client+does+not+exist. Hosted UI copy: An error was encountered with the requested page.

Not a missing Cognito client. The development SpaClient exists and matches SSM. Auth deploy updated CallbackURLs in place (silent-callback); it did not replace the client. Logout URLs already include /auth/signout-callback.

Cause reproduced with curl: Cognito hosted UI logout is GET /logout?client_id=...&logout_uri=... oidc-client-ts signoutRedirect uses OIDC end_session_endpoint with post_logout_redirect_uri and id_token_hint, and global extraQueryParams attach identity_provider=Google. Without client_id, /logout 302s to /login?identity_provider=Google (no client_id), which 302s to /error?error=Client+does+not+exist — the exact page. With client_id and logout_uri, /logout 302s to /auth/signout-callback.

Fix: Gherkin first. signOut() must pass extraQueryParams client_id and logout_uri. Remove identity_provider from global UserManager extraQueryParams; keep it only on signInWithGoogle. select_account only after completeSignOutRedirect. Do not send identity_provider on logout or silent renew.

Relates to closed 349634 (CI-closed; this is the live hole) and 5e4c9a.

Done when: Sign Out on development returns to the workspace signed out, not the Cognito error page. Next Sign in still shows the account chooser.
